intro: The Comoros grows much of the world's ylang-ylang, used in perfumes, and vanilla and cloves.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Ylang-ylang essence, vanilla and cloves are the main exports. Money sent home from France is very important.

keyTerms.meaning: A fragrant flower used in perfume.

cardGroups.title: Made in the Comoros
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Comoros makes and sells to the world.
